reason: Hypothesis A proposes a containerless, in-situ synchrotron approach that directly addresses contamination and nucleation artifacts—key limitations in high-temperature HEA measurements—with a physically sound mechanism and a specific, testable falsification experiment. Hypothesis B relies on a sequential DSC-ultrasonic-PVT method that does not convincingly overcome container-induced errors and lacks the same level of mechanistic integration and precision for the stated constraints.
